rule: Clawling mascot app icon system. Light and dark assets share the same colorful self-contained rounded-square icon for consistent recognition across themes.

variants.clawling-app-icon-master-1024.png: Clean generated app icon master with transparent rounded corners.
variants.logo-app.ico: Windows icon container generated from app master.
variants.logo-app.icns: macOS icon container generated from app master.

theme.light: full-color Clawling icon on transparent rounded-square canvas
theme.dark: same full-color icon for recognition on dark UI
